question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Lazy
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Lazy"** means unwilling to work or use energy; characterized by lack of effort or activity. (आलसी)

 
 
• **Example: **He was too **lazy** to get out of bed and missed the entire morning class.
 
 
 
• **"Diligent"** refers to showing **care and conscientiousness in one's work or duties**. (परिश्रमी)
 
 
• **Example: **She is a **diligent **student, always completing her assignments on time and with great detail.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Lazy' **is **'Diligent'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Genuine **(असली): Truly what something is said to be; authentic.

 
 
• **Example:** She was praised for her** genuine **concern for her colleagues.
 
 
 
• **Barren **(बंजर): Too poor to produce much or any vegetation; unproductive.
 
 
• **Example: **The **barren** land stretched for miles with no sign of greenery.
 
 
 
• **Helpful** (सहायक): Giving or ready to give help.
 
 
• **Example:** The staff at the hotel were very** helpful **and made our stay comfortable.
